categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of lithium-ion battery cathode materials, focusing on lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4) and iron phosphate products. It also develops sodium-ion battery cathode materials and manganese iron phosphate materials, serving the new energy vehicle and energy storage sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced synthesis methods such as high-temperature solid-state synthesis, co-precipitation, sol-gel, and hydrothermal methods for cathode material production. It has proprietary technologies including metal ion doping, polymer composite carbon sources, grain size control, and surface modification to enhance battery performance. The firm also invests in solid-state electrolyte and high-density pressing technologies to improve energy density and cycle life.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major domestic lithium battery manufacturers and energy storage companies, including leading new energy vehicle battery producers. The products are primarily used in power batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage batteries, with growing overseas market penetration.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Hubei, Shandong, Anhui, and other provinces. It is expanding its global footprint with subsidiaries and projects in the United States, Singapore, Kazakhstan, Rwanda, and other countries, aiming to enhance its international market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the lithium battery supply chain, producing cathode materials and precursors. It integrates upstream precursor production with downstream cathode material manufacturing, providing a vertically integrated supply chain advantage.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include technological innovation in high-density lithium iron phosphate materials, sodium-ion battery cathode materials, and manganese iron phosphate. The company emphasizes R&D collaboration with top universities and institutes, patent development, and the commercialization of solid-state battery components. It also focuses on cost reduction, efficiency improvement, and expanding production capacity domestically and internationally.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of lithium-ion battery cathode materials and related products. The company employs a direct sales model with some consignment sales, serving primarily domestic customers with increasing exports. Revenue is recognized at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic producer of lithium iron phosphate cathode materials with a strong R&D capability and comprehensive product portfolio. It competes with other major Chinese cathode material manufacturers and is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative enterprise. Its market share is bolstered by long-term partnerships with top battery manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 7.52 billion, a 38.21% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to raw material price declines despite a 39.07% increase in sales volume. Net loss attributable to shareholders narrowed to RMB -870 million. The company has total assets of RMB 17.68 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 5.62 billion, reflecting ongoing capacity expansion and investment in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, high-performance cathode materials with superior electrochemical properties such as high pressing density, cycle life, and safety. Its integrated precursor and cathode material production ensures cost control and product consistency. Continuous innovation in new battery chemistries and solid-state technologies differentiates it in the competitive lithium battery materials market.
